voice.name: Open Sector - Drone Op
voice.description: Young male drone operator around twenty, quick-talking tech geek with a light nasal tone, enthusiastic and a little smug, sounds like he is talking with a controller in his hands and his eyes on a screen, casual slang, playful, more excited about gadgets than about the war.
voice.sample: Drone op here, batteries charged and props spinning. Give me a target and I'll give you eyes from the sky. Honestly, this thing flies better than half our pilots.

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt with backpack of electronics and antenna rattling, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Small quadcopter drone spinning up its four electric propellers from rest then lifting off and climbing away, rising buzzing whine, close, outdoors, no music, no voice
